notes.title: Plan for 《Spark Dimension:Rebirth》
notes.content:
Hello everyone:
   I am the Asixa, the developer of Spark Dimension.
   Today I made a major decision ——Spark Dimension would totally redo in 2018

   [url=https://www.wenjuan.in/s/ie2EZ3/]here[/url] is a questionnaire about the new version, thank you for your participation
 
[h1]Q&A:[/h1]
[b] Why totally redo? [/b]
This project began at 2014, until now, the total code has more than two hundred thousand lines, for me, it is too difficult to continue to maintain this project.  I will develop multiplayer system in the new version, I would like to redo rather than modify the old codes.

[b]is it necessary to redo this game ?[/b]
Well, although the sales and comments of this game are not very good, but I will still go on this game, because this is my first game, which I spent 4 years into, I will continue to do so.

[b] Why not redo now? [/b]
Because I am still preparing TOEFL and the ACT examination,I don't have enough time now.

[b] Will the price increase in new version ? [/b]
Yes, because the new version will have better quality than now and more perfect, and has multiplayer mode.

[b] What is the plan?[/b]
If no accident, I will start the development in the beginning of next year, and then the game will finished before September 1, 2018.

[b] Why the game will be finished before September 1? [/b]
At the end of August 2018 I will go to the United States to study, then the studio will be re-planned.

[b] How to participate in the development of the new version? [/b]
I will be in the community and the game official website to update the monthly new game content, recording new content to YouTube. you can give me comments and suggestions anytime.

notes.title: New version of the announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone
       I'm Steve Louis, the new developer of Spark Dimension.
       I would assist Asixa to develop the Spark Dimension these days because he need to prepare his examinations this year, thank you for your support.
       We are working on designing a better Spark Dimension. 
       We will launch the Beta version in early 2018, and release the final version before September 2018.

In the coming beta version
1.There will be more interesting new items and buildings
2 There will be a new creation system that can give you a better experience
3 There will be more AI enemies and bosses. We think they will be cool.
4 There will be a new terrain generation system with different biomes and landscapes which we already done.
5 Spark Dimension will have multiplayer game system
6 Complete game plot

      You can leave comments or suggestions in community to help us make this game better
                                                                                            - Steve Louis

notes.title: About this game development plan
notes.content:
Dear Players:
I am sorry.
I recently faced some important exam (On May I have high school academic level test,On June I have TOEFL test,on July the second TOEFL,on September the ACT (American College Testing),on December the second  ACT) 
So the development process may be some procrastinate, [b]but I did not give up the game [/b].
In the next period of time, I will only continue to repair some of the details and bugs.
Until the end of this year, I will with my friends to form a game studio to develop more content.
during the times waiting for college admission, I will fully develop this game,add more features, such as multiplayer games.
You can go [url=https://trello.com/b/EQPq96fE/sparkdimension]here[/url] to see the Roadmap of this game.
Thanks for your waiting.

notes.title: Big Update：Aplha 1.0.9
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after nearly 2 months not updated, I decided to release Alpha 1.0.9
Because I am the only people to develop this game and in the development process encountered many technical problems, as well as time planning problems, So long time no update
I am not a full-time game developer, but I have put all my free time into the development of this game.

For this new version of it!
The reason is not Alpha1.10 but Alpha1.0.9 because I have two important elements not completed
You can set the game to [beta] (right click - properties - betas ) to play to Alpha1.0.9 version

[h1] What is the difference between Alpha1.0.9 and Alpha1.0.0? [/h1]

1. Unlimited random alien maps
2. The new main interface UI
3. New resources
4. optimization
5. and many more


[H1] Some minor changes: [/h1]
1. Interactive objects are highlighted
2. Remove the drop damage
3. The blocks can no longer be placed in the sky


[H1] What will Alpha1.1.0 be? [/H1]
1. More creations components
2. AI (randomly generated alien spacecraft)
3. Recalculate the weight of the creation vehicle

Thank you for the support I will release Alpha1.1.0 version as soon as possible

notes.title: Spark Dimension pricing
notes.content:
Dear players:

I decided to lower the price of Sparks Dimension to $9.99.

Players who bought this game at original price and played only within 2 hours can apply for [u][b]refund[/b][/u] . Then, you can rebuy it at the newest price. More details please see [url=http://store.steampowered.com/steam_refunds/]here[/url]

Those whose playing time is more than 2 hours can send their proof of purchase (receipt e-mail) to Asixa@foxmail.com I will check it within 48 hours and send back a [u][b]new steam key[/b][/u] . You can trade with this new key. It is also a good choice to give your new key to your friends as a gift after Sparks Dimension launch its multi-player mode.

[b] Please notice the time of your purchase in your receipt e-mail. You can only get  your compensation when your time of purchasing is prior to 2016-10-14.[/b] 

The reason of the decrease of the price is that I have realized that my game is still at its early acces stage and it still needs more details and contents. A high price will be in the way of its future development.

Thank you for your patience and support.
